messages:
alex: CI on master is red — macos-clang shard failing with a bunch of missing Qt headers after today's toolchain image roll. Anyone seen this?
ci-bot: CI build #4721 failed on macos-clang-12. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/build/4721 (exit code 1)
morgan: I ran into something similar locally after the Xcode/toolchain bump. Could be SDK include path change.
riyad: can you paste the top error lines? might be an include path symlink that got removed in the image. also which bazelrc are we using on CI?
alex: here are the first errors from the log:
```
In file included from third_party/qt/src/widgets/qapplication.cpp:12:
In file included from third_party/qt/include/QtWidgets/QApplication:1:
fatal error: 'QtWidgets/qapplication' file not found
#include <QtWidgets/qapplication>
         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```
jen: assigning a quick bisect to @sam to see which image introduced it. last known good image id: image-20240217-1, suspect image: image-20240305-2.
sam: on it, kicking off the bisect script now. will try `bazel clean --expunge` + local repro and then iterate images.
morgan: short-term workaround: add explicit include path to third_party/qt/include in the cmake toolchain file so the header resolves, but that's a patchy fix.
riyad: if bisect points to the toolchain image, infra will need to either revert or patch the image to restore the symlink or SDK paths. also try clearing remote cache in case cached artifacts are mismatched.
alex: thanks — Sam, please ping here with the bisect result. if it narrows to the image I'll open a rollback PR for infra to consider. :eyes: 
sam: bisect complete — regression introduced in image-20240305-2, failure reproduces in that image on my laptop when running the dockerized CI job. filing infra ticket: INFRA-1872 with repro steps and logs. cc @infra-team
ci-bot: Ticket INFRA-1872 created: https://issues.redwood.example/INFRA-1872
alex: great, thanks Sam. marking the master red and adding hold for any dependent rollouts until infra confirms.
